subject.title: [Feature Request] Windows 版本缺失「沉浸音效」配置项

question: Should immersive or ambient audio be documented as platform-specific app behavior, added to the Windows companion app, or promoted into OpenClaw's cross-platform config schema?
rationale: The source confirms the missing schema/docs surface, but the right owner boundary changes product behavior and may add a new public config contract.

options.title: Document Platform Behavior
options.body: Clarify the Windows support status now and avoid adding a core config key unless the feature is promoted later.

options.title: Add Windows App Setting
options.body: Implement a Windows companion-app setting that mirrors the macOS app-local sound control without changing core config.

options.title: Add Cross-Platform Config
options.body: Define and test a new core immersive-audio config contract across apps and docs.

recommendation.title: Document Platform Behavior
recommendation.body: Clarify the Windows support status now and avoid adding a core config key unless the feature is promoted later.

likelyOwner.reason: The current config/docs evidence points most directly to recent schema and Windows docs ownership.
